cohort: 2654 women recruited before 17 weeks of pregnancy
finding: Panic disorder and GAD do not contribute to adverse pregnancy complications, however, maternal treatment with benzodiazepines and serotonin reuptake inhibitors during pregnancy is associated with various adverse maternal and neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Maternal benzodiazepine use was associated with cesarean delivery, while maternal serotonin reuptake inhibitor use was associated with cesarean delivery and hypertensive diseases of pregnancy.
